Times Music Spiritual present Hanuman Chalisa sung by Shankar Mahadevan. As the Hanuman Chalisa unfolds verse by verse, Lord Hanuman’s many qualities are enumerated. This hymn is sung and recited by devotees who believe that the greatest of Ram Bhaktas, Hanuman, will bless them. It bestows protection from illness, adversaries, and adversities. Lord Hanuman is considered to be the God of Life whose worship increases life force. Increased life force gives us the strength to do anything, removing fear, mistrust, doubt from within us.
Track - Hanuman Chalisa
Singer - Shankar Mahadevan
